entries.name: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
KGI Bank
highlights: Identified operational pain points in the corporate cash flow and account platform, then initiated and independently delivered a 0-to-1 self-service support tool that turns long PDF manuals into a lightweight Chrome extension.
Led a multimodal RAG pipeline over illustrated manuals, combining LayoutLM layout analysis with VLM image captioning to fix the spatial and step-order loss of traditional OCR.
Built a navigation engine with React 19 and driver.js, covering state recovery across page reloads, multi-node overlay tracking, and input focus protection to reduce inbound support requests.

entries.name: ShenYi Autonomous Health Co., Ltd.
highlights: Independently delivered two Vue.js frontends and a Django backend, designing and implementing 80+ RESTful APIs across payments, membership, RBAC, and JWT authentication.
Built and operated five core microservices on AWS, improving availability and response time through service decomposition and traffic distribution.
Acted as the cross-project technical liaison, aligning API contracts and system dependencies while enforcing least privilege across AWS IAM and GitHub organization permissions.
Integrated the LINE Messaging API for automated messaging and maintained the WordPress corporate site and SEO configuration.

entries.name: Institute for Information Industry (III)

Modeled high-concurrency conversation data in MongoDB with paginated queries, and standardized deployment environments with Docker.

entries.name: BigData Software Co., Ltd.
highlights: Operated a distributed crawling architecture across 100+ news and blog sites, sustaining tens of thousands of text records per day.
Implemented dynamic proxy pools, request header rotation, and exponential backoff retries to bypass IP blocking and rate limiting.
Built a Pandas ETL pipeline for text cleaning, missing values, and schema standardization, exposing the results through a low-latency RESTful API.

entries.name: Institute for Information Industry (III)
highlights: Built an internal AI chat module on a WordPress site, integrating the OpenAI Chat API with PHP and streaming responses to the frontend.
Developed a dynamic Selenium crawler to extract company data and established a cleaning pipeline.
Researched FinTech accelerators and ESG trends, producing reports used for park strategy planning.

entries.title: FinNexus – Financial RAG Search & QA
entries.desc: A full-stack financial QA service covering filing ingestion, regulation parsing, and hybrid retrieval, with FastAPI as the RAG control plane.
highlights: Orchestrated idempotent ingestion of MOPS filings, MinerU PDF parsing, and regulation data with parent-child and article-level chunking.
Built BGE-M3 dense and sparse hybrid indexes in Qdrant with RRF fusion, Cross-Encoder reranking, and intent-based routing.
Answers are grounded in retrieved content with document, page, and article citations, and are refused when evidence is insufficient.

entries.title: FinCortex – Investment Research Decision Engine
entries.desc: A LangGraph system orchestrating five agents: planner, tool_caller, critic, arbitrator, and synthesizer.
highlights: Replaced linear ReAct with Plan-and-Execute plus Critic Reflection, bounded by triple limits so every branch converges.
Arbitrates conflicts between cold and hot data with a time-decay model, computing all numbers in a restricted Python sandbox.
Persists graph state in a Postgres checkpointer for multi-turn conversations and node-level resumption.

entries.title: Web Harvester – Config-Driven Crawler Engine
entries.desc: A crawler system that decouples site rules from the scheduling engine through declarative configuration and modular design.
highlights: YAML rules validated by JSON Schema, so new sites require configuration changes only.
Simulates browser TLS fingerprints with curl_cffi and retries with exponential backoff for stable collection.
Ships with ETL cleaning and multiple storage backends to normalize heterogeneous sources.

entries.title: Discord Music Bot – Cross-Platform Streaming Control
entries.desc: A music streaming service integrating Discord voice with a React web dashboard, using FastAPI as the central control hub.
highlights: Connects Discord.py with a React frontend through RESTful APIs and a custom playback queue for two-way sync.
Implements Discord OAuth2 and JWT verification to manage identity and personal playlists.
Containerizes the Vite SPA and backend with Docker Compose for one-command deployment.

entries.title: Taiwan Takoyaki Price Index
entries.desc: An interactive map of takoyaki prices across Taiwan built with React, TypeScript, and D3.js.
highlights: Combines store prices, locations, and administrative statistics with city and district level views.
Designs price normalization and statistics, showing color scales, means, medians, and sample sizes.
Covered by Vitest unit tests with type checking and linting, deployed on GitHub Pages.

entries.title: DevColor Inspector – Color Analysis Extension
entries.desc: A Chrome extension for color picking and analysis built with React, TypeScript, and Manifest V3.
highlights: Offers EyeDropper picking, HEX / RGB input, and OKLCH scale generation.
Uses culori for multi-format conversion and exports CSS Variables, Tailwind tokens, and JSON.
Manages settings and color history with chrome.storage, with bilingual UI and dark/light themes.
